title: org.apache.logging.log4j.message.ReusableMessageFactory can not be instantiated reflectively
body:
**Describe the bug**
Generated native image, Elasticsearch bulk writer crashes already in BulkProcessor$Builder (stacktrace below). I closed a related issue yesterday (see #13528) because at the time I only tried ES searches (via QueryBuilder) and they worked fine. It might be that it needs some extra reflection config json (no idea how, sorry) but I hoped I can live without digging that deep...

**Expected behavior**
I included as advised the dependency to `commons-logging-jboss-logging` and I didn't expect issues from log4j2 anymore...

**To Reproduce**
If it's not something obvious I missed, I'll create also a reproducer.

**Configuration**
```properties
quarkus.http.cors=true
quarkus.ssl.native=true
quarkus.native.additional-build-args=-H:DynamicProxyConfigurationFiles=proxies.json
quarkus.log.console.enable=true
quarkus.log.level=INFO
```

**Screenshots**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3449432/100679288-773ffa00-336f-11eb-9c04-d5a9890f8e83.png)

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
- AWS Lambda, custom runtime V2
- Mandrel 20.3-java11
- Quarkus 1.10.0.FINAL

**Additional context**
I tried to exclude `log4j2-jboss-logmanager` from the ES client but that failed already the image generation (not surprising)
